summary: Array of single-location tasks. Provide jobs and/or shipments (at least one of the two required).
range: Array of job objects. Each requires id + location_index.
constraints: At least one of jobs / shipments must be present.
Each job requires id and location_index.

testingGuidance: Negative: request with neither jobs nor shipments -> 400.
